facts.text: SimpleNavEnv subclasses gym.Env
step unpacks its action into v1 and v2, the left and right wheel velocities
maxVel is 4, the value used in the C++ sferes2 experiment
step clips both motor orders to -maxVel through +maxVel before moving the robot
The action space is Box(low=-maxVel, high=maxVel, shape=(2,), dtype=float32)

The observation-space high array is maxSensorRange repeated n_lasers, then 1.0 repeated twice, then 1.0 repeated n_lightsensors; low is 0.0 repeated n_lasers, 0.0 repeated twice and -1 (or 0 in realistic mode) repeated n_lightsensors
get_all_sensors returns only the laser ranges: the bumper and light-sensor terms are commented out
get_laserranges maps a negative laser distance to maxSensorRange and clips the rest to 0..maxSensorRange
maxSensorRange is the first laser's range, or 0 when the robot has no laser
step calls robot.move(left, right, map, sticky_walls) once with the clipped motor orders
step sets episode_over to dist_obj <= goal.get_diam(), the goal's full diameter
step returns the legacy 4-tuple (sensors, reward, episode_over, info) with info dist_obj and robot_pos
The default reward_func is binary_goalbased
binary_goalbased returns 1.0 when the goal distance is at most goalRadius and 0.0 otherwise
goalRadius is half the goal diameter
The other reward functions are minimize_energy (minus the sum of the absolute motor orders), displacement (distance from the previous position) and none (0)
reset restores the initial pose, zeroes both motor orders and returns get_all_sensors(); it draws no random number and takes no seed
kitchen_env is assets/kitchen.xml
kitchen_lasers_env is assets/kitchen_lasers.xml
kitchen-v0 is registered with entry_point gym_fastsim.simple_nav:SimpleNavEnv and kwargs xml_env=join(dirname(__file__), kitchen_env)
kitchen-v1 is registered with entry_point gym_fastsim.simple_nav:SimpleNavEnv and kwargs xml_env=join(dirname(__file__), kitchen_lasers_env)
kitchen_lasers.xml places the robot at x=2, y=4, theta=0, the goal at x=0.5, y=0.5 with diameter 0.2, and ten lasers of range 1
kitchen_lasers.xml names the map kitchen.pbm
assets/kitchen.xml names the map cuisine.pbm
The first simulation environment is based on the fast simulation library libfastsim

determinism.notes: the upstream reset restores a fixed initial pose and draws no random number (nav_env.py:217-223), so a trajectory is a function of the action sequence; the bridge still exposes and echoes a seed, and this package's fake uses no random number either

gaps: kinematic/analytic F0 stand-in: the fake integrates a differential-drive placeholder and synthesizes laser values; it does not call libfastsim's robot.move, model rigid-body dynamics, wall contacts, sensor geometry, wheel slip or noise
timestep_ms is 0 because the clone states no integration interval for robot.move; one tick is one robot.move call and the fake advances one discrete transition per tick

the observation space declares n_lasers+2+n_lightsensors bounds (nav_env.py:118-119) while get_all_sensors returns only the n_lasers laser readings (nav_env.py:182-184); the fake mirrors the mismatch: 12 bounds in the space and 10 values returned for kitchen-v1
the upstream reset ignores a seed and restores the fixed initial pose; a seed does not change a trajectory, and the fake mirrors that
the reward and terminal rule follow the clone: goalRadius is half the goal diameter (nav_env.py:114-116) while episode_over compares the distance to the full goal diameter (nav_env.py:209-210)

no rendering is served (cap.world.render.v1 stays unbound); the info fields pose, acceleration, velocity and time listed in README.md:136-143 are not returned by step, which returns only dist_obj and robot_pos (nav_env.py:212)
no physical device is modelled and the model was never validated against one

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the world state is kept and stays readable
